rule: Use Acuitik built-in material files when possible; if original material is missing, substitute with the closest available built-in material.

substitution_table.reason: HSQ/cured silica-like material; SiO2 is the closest chemically appropriate built-in oxide.
PSS is polymer-like with n about 1.50; Acrylic is built-in with n about 1.49.
No carbon/SOC material is built in; Acrylic is the closest low-index organic substitute, though it lacks SOC absorption.
No TiO2 is built in; Al2O3 is the highest-index built-in oxide, but underestimates TiO2 n.
No HfO2 is built in; Al2O3 is the closest built-in high-index oxide.
No Cu or SiN substrate is built in; Si is a high-index semiconductor substrate available in the page.

limitations: TiO2 and HfO2 both map to Al2O3 under the built-in-material-only rule, so this calculation cannot compare TiO2 vs HfO2.
Acrylic does not include SOC/PSS absorption; metal layers such as Cr and Cu are unavailable in the page material list.
